d: Naveen Kumar was at the heart of India’s raiding attack at CWKC 2026. Featuring in all 7 matches, he led the way with 43 raid points from 57 raids at an impressive 75% strike rate. His consistency and impact earned him the Fans’ Choice Favourite Raider honour. Relive his standout raids from the tournament on prokabaddi.com or the Pro Kabaddi Official App.
